segments.arabic:
١١٩٩٨- أم حبيب بنت عامر
بن خالد بن عمر بن قريط. لها إدراك. ذكر الواقديّ أن النبي ﵌ كتب إلى بني حارثة بن عمرو سنة تسع يدعوهم إلى الإسلام، فأخذوا الصحيفة فغسلوها ورقعوا بها دلوهم، فقالت أم حبيب بنت عامر منكرة عليهم:
إذا ما أتتهم آية من محمّد ... محوها بماء البئر فهو عصير
[الطويل]
segments.english:
11998—Umm Habib bint 'Amir

ibn Khalid ibn 'Umar ibn Qurayt. She lived into the Prophet's time. al-Waqidi related that in the ninth year the Prophet—may Allah bless him and grant him peace—wrote to Banu Haritha ibn 'Amr, calling them to Islam. They took the document, washed it, and patched their bucket with it. Umm Habib bint 'Amir, denouncing them, said:

Whenever a message from Muhammad came to them,
they erased it with water from the well—thus it is juice.

[Long meter]

unresolved.explanation: The literal sense, “thus it is juice,” is preserved, but the intended wordplay or rhetorical force cannot be determined from the supplied evidence.
